This is an AI course made by content creators for content creators, so you can cut through all of the noise online and focus on the most important things you really need to accomplish your goals. If you're anything like me every day, you see a post from some social media influencer talking about this game changing new AI that just came out and how you need to start using it. 99% of the time, the tool is absolute garbage, and the creator is simply being paid by the company to talk about the tool and make people feel like they're missing out by not using it. This course has none of that. We will only cover what actually works and will help you achieve your goals. ## Full Video Transcript

Every single day artificial intelligence is updating and there are new tools being released to the market. In this quick but very important video, I want to let you know how I'm going to be handling this in regard to the content within the course. By doing this, you and I will be on the same exact page and you'll also know exactly how to get the most up-to-date content. Generally speaking, when a new tool is introduced or there has been an update, I categorize it into one of two buckets. The first bucket is a performance update. With a performance update, the way that you use the tool to get the output hasn't changed at all. It's just better at producing the output. An example of this would be like 5G cellular service on a phone. You do not have to use your phone any differently when you're on 5G service, you're just going to get a better result because it's stronger or whatever else happens with 5G. When it comes to these performance updates, I'm going to let you know of them in the written description beneath the modules. So say for example, in the module we're using version 1.5, but then a month later version 1.6 comes out. The way you use the tool hasn't changed, but there is a new name for it. So I will denote that in the description beneath the video and let you know of any other small changes that you just should be aware of. So long story short, after watching a video, always just quickly check that description for any relevant information you might need to know. So that's the first type of update, a performance update. The second type is a process update. This is very different. Okay, this is when a completely new process is required. Maybe a new tool came out or they just vastly updated the AI model so that you just have to take different actions. Okay, a major upgrade like this to the process would render the original video that's included in this course, obsolete because it's teaching an outdated method. Anytime this happens, I'm committed to recreating that video so you all have the best information. Just keep in mind, it does take a little while to script the video, shoot the video, have our editors edit it and then upload it to the course. So they'll always be a slight time delay, but we will do our best to stay as on top of that information as possible. Realistically, you'll never even notice this, okay, because the up-to-date content will just replace the older content and you'll never know. But that does it. I know there wasn't much training content in this video. I just think it's a really important topic that I wanted to cover with all of you as you're going throughout this course, because this is such a fast-changing landscape. It's super exciting, but it can be overwhelming for everyone. And I just want to be your guide throughout the process and make amazing content that you all can learn from. So if you ever have any feedback or questions, you can always email us at support at contentcreditor.com. Other than that, dive into this content, supercharge your workflow with AI, and I'll see you in the next video.

You basically start vague and then you refine deeper and deeper by just having a conversation with the AI. With each iteration, I'm guiding the AI closer to the perfect result instead of just trying to get it all right in one shot. Strategy number four is reverse engineer prompting. And this is one of my absolute favorite advanced strategies. Let's say you come across an image online that you want to recreate or even modify with AI. Here's how you can do it. INTERIOR + EXTERIOR DESIGN

Create an entirely new image featuring the perfume bottle from image one placed in a beach environment similar to image two.
The camera angle for the new photo should be from ground level, somewhat of a tight shot focused on the perfume bottle, which is resting in the sand on the beach.
Create a new image featuring the perfume bottle from image one and the man from image two.
The man should be standing center frame in the image. In one hand he holds the perfume bottle to the camera. With his other hand, he points at the perfume bottle.
The perfume bottle should be in perfect focus, where the man in the background is slightly blurred and out of focus.
The man is looking at the camera and smiling.
Change the man's outfit from image one so it matches the outfit from image two.
YOUTUBE THUMBNAILS
Create a 16 by 9 YouTube thumbnail image for a camera review video.
It’s a close up shot of the man from image one holding the camera from image two up to the camera.
The focus of the image is clearly on the camera in the foreground, but slightly blurred.

CAMERA ANGLE CHANGES
Change the camera angle so it is a close up shot showing only the man's feet as he walks.
Change the camera angle from image one so that it is a new shot looking over the shoulder of the spider back at the man.
Use the face from image two as a reference for how the man should look.
CHARACTER CONSISTENCY
Using the lizard man from image one, create a new image showing the lizard man in hiking clothes at the top of a mountain in Switzerland.
Using the lizard man from image one, create a new image showing the lizard man in a high stakes board meeting.
He has placed his hands on the side of his head, indicating that he is very stressed out.
On a large whiteboard in the boardroom, there is a graph with text SALES at the top.
The graph is trending down, indicating that his business is struggling.
RECTANGLE PLACEMENT METHOD
Recreate the image.
Add a white carpet on the floor marked by the red rectangle.
Add a tall light in the area marked by the white rectangle.
Add a large plant in the area marked by the blue rectangle.

Recreate the image and add a very large spaceship in the sky off in the distance, following along with the basic sketch provided.

static tripod shot. The moving truck drives away from the house.

static tripod shot. The man places one plate on top of the plates in the open cabinet above him, he then places both hands on the sides of the cardboard box and looks down at it. As he does this, a dark shadow walks behind the window
Very slow dolly movement backwards. The fog slowly moves around the house. Ominous feeling. Horror movie
The man sits up and gets out of bed. He looks nervously confused.
static tripod shot. The man turns around extremely slowly in fear. Once he is fully turned around, he sees something and freezes with fear, petrified by what he sees. His eyes stay locked just past the camera, staring at an unseen entity that is terrifying him.

Template prompt elements
Subject Action
→
What is the subject doing?
“The woman is turning slowly to face the camera,”
“A bird is soaring across a mountain ridge,”
“A samurai stands still as cherry blossoms fall.”
Camera Movement
→
What’s the motion of the camera?
“A slow dolly-in from behind,”
“360 orbit around the subject,”
“Cinematic handheld zoom out.”
Emotion / Mood / Tone
→
What should the viewer feel?
“Evokes loneliness and wonder,”
“Feels tense and dramatic,”
“Hopeful and inspiring.”
Example Prompts:
A lone astronaut drifts weightlessly through the void, silhouetted against the curve of Earth, their tether slowly unraveling behind them.
The camera performs a slow, upward dolly-in from below, stars glimmering with subtle parallax as the vastness of space surrounds them.
Evokes a deep sense of isolation, wonder, and the fragility of life.
A barefoot child darts through a sea of golden sunflowers, arms stretched out like airplane wings, laughter echoing faintly in the breeze.
The camera gently tracks from the side at golden hour, lens flaring with every turn toward the setting sun.
Feels warm, joyful, and soaked in nostalgia.
An elderly man sits beneath a broken umbrella on a rain-slick bench, staring down at a faded photo in his hands, unmoving as the storm falls around him.
A slow crane shot descends through the leaves above, eventually resting at eye level, raindrops catching the light like tiny memories.
Evokes sorrow, solitude, and quiet reflection.
A wolf stands atop a snowy cliff, fur rippling in the wind, and lets out a haunting howl as clouds part to reveal a glowing full moon.
The camera circles in a slow 360 orbit, capturing the moonlight shifting across the snow-covered landscape below.
Feels wild, majestic, and ancient.
A dancer moves freely across a dusty warehouse floor, twirling through beams of sunlight slicing in through broken windows.
The handheld camera sways with her rhythm, circling her movements with subtle breath-like motion.
Evokes raw emotion, self-expression, and liberation.
A lone soldier walks slowly down a rubble-strewn street, flames flickering in broken windows, smoke curling behind them as sirens echo faintly.
A long tracking shot from behind follows them steadily, slight handheld jitter adding realism and grit.
Feels tense, grounded, and emotionally heavy.
A couple stands close on a rooftop, gazing over a glowing city skyline, neon reflections dancing in their eyes as they hold each other in silence.
A drone slowly rises and pulls back, revealing the city sprawling endlessly beneath them as soft music swells in the background.
Feels intimate, cinematic, and filled with possibility.
A monk kneels in front of an ancient altar, hands steady as he lights a candle, the flame flickering gently in the quiet dusk of the temple.
Locked-off wide shot slowly zooms in, incense smoke drifting through rays of sunlight breaking through lattice windows.
Evokes serenity, sacredness, and inner peace.
A young woman unfolds a letter with trembling hands in a dimly lit bedroom, eyes scanning the page before tears silently begin to fall.
A slow dolly-in captures her expression shift from confusion to heartbreak, shallow focus blurring the world around her.
Feels deeply personal, emotional, and heartbreaking.
A masked protester steps forward in the fog, locking eyes with a wall of riot police, as wind carries torn flyers and ash through the air.
The camera pushes forward in slow motion, debris floating around the frame, tension crackling in the stillness.
Evokes resistance, courage, and high-stakes drama.

Visual Style Cheat Sheet:

Prompt Framework:
🔹 Image to Video Prompt Requirements
Subject Action
→ What is the subject doing?
Examples:
“The woman is turning slowly to face the camera.”
“A bird is soaring across a mountain ridge.”
“A samurai stands still as cherry blossoms fall.”
Camera Movement
→ How is the camera moving?
Examples:
“A slow dolly-in from behind.”
“360° orbit around the subject.”
“Cinematic handheld zoom out.”
Emotion / Mood / Tone
→ What should the viewer feel?
Examples:
“Evokes loneliness and wonder.”
“Feels tense and dramatic.”
“Hopeful and inspiring.”
🔹 Additional “text to video” prompt requirements
Subject(s)
Clearly define what or who is in the scene:
Is it a person, animal, object, or something fantastical?
Are there multiple subjects?
Does the focus shift from one subject to another?
Shot Type / Framing
→ How is the subject composed in the shot?
Examples:
“Close-up of the subject’s eyes.”
“Wide establishing shot of a mountain range.”
“Over-the-shoulder view of a man reading a letter.”
Environment / Setting
→ Where is the scene taking place?
Examples:
“Inside a cozy cabin during a snowstorm.”
“On a moving train at sunset.”
“Deep in a dense forest with fog.”
Visual Style
→ What style should the AI try to mimic?
Examples:
Hyper-realistic
Pixar-style 3D animation
Studio Ghibli-inspired
Marvel comics aesthetic
(Note: Not all models support every style equally well.)
🔹 Bonus Enhancements (Optional but Powerful)
Lighting Style
→ What kind of lighting is used in the scene?
Consider:
Color temperature: warm, cool, neutral
Light source: front-lit, backlit, side-lit, low lighting
Time of day: morning, noon, golden hour, night
Atmosphere / Environmental Effects
→ Add realism and texture to the scene
Examples:
Fog, rain, snow, wind, smoke, dust, embers
“Golden hour light with floating dust particles.”
“Rain trickling down a glass window in the background.”
Color Palette
→ Define the tone and feel through color
Examples:
“Muted vintage tones with a grainy film texture.”
“High-saturation neons like Blade Runner.”
“Warm, earth-toned medieval aesthetic.”
Example Prompts:
DIVER
A lone cliff diver leaps from a jagged seaside cliff as the camera tracks tightly beside him, following his descent in one smooth motion before gliding underwater with him. Bubbles drift past while rays of light pierce through the surface. The moment blends adrenaline and calm focus, framed as a dynamic follow shot that widens slightly underwater to reveal the diver against illuminated blue depths. Set during golden hour along a rugged coast, the scene shifts from warm sunlit tones to cool underwater hues in a hyper cinematic, high contrast visual style with soft depth of field and natural motion blur.
SAMURAI
A lone samurai in weathered armor and a masked rival in dark robes engage in a rapid, precise sword duel. Their blades clash intensely as the camera dynamically tracks and circles them with dramatic push-ins during impacts. The mood is tense, fierce, and focused, filled with honor and determination. Framed in a medium-wide shot, both fighters remain visible with brief close emphasis on blade contact and footwork. Set in a misty bamboo forest at dawn with drifting leaves and soft light beams. Rendered in a cinematic, high contrast style with subtle film grain inspired by classic samurai cinema and modern action films.
DESK
A focused middle-aged man sketches detailed illustrations in a notebook at his desk, his hand moving fluidly as he refines lines and shading with quiet intensity. The camera performs a slow cinematic dolly-in from a medium-wide shot into a subtle over-the-shoulder perspective with slight handheld movement. The mood is calm, introspective, and warmly inspiring. The shot centers on the man, his sketchbook, scattered drawing tools, and surrounding creative objects like pinned artwork, books, and decor. Framing gradually tightens into a more intimate perspective while keeping soft environmental context. The setting is a cozy home office with warm lighting, wooden textures, plants, and layered creative clutter. The visual style is cinematic realism with soft warm color grading, shallow depth of field, natural light, and gentle bokeh.

Lesson Recap:
Train ChatGPT on your existing or new channel, by submitting the following info:
A brief description of your channel, what type of content do you create, what makes your content unique, who is your typical viewer, and what does that viewer like MOST about you and your content
A list of similar channels to yours, or channels that you aspire to be like
If you have posted videos already, give ChatGPT the best titles from your most successful videos
Prompt Template: "Can you help me come up with ten video ideas, each with their own unique, engaging, and curiosity driven title"
From there, pick your favorite title and create 5-10 variations of that title
Prompt Template: "I really like this idea [paste favorite title] can you please come up with 5 variations of this title, each one engaging, curiosity driven, and under 60 characters"
After that, either pick your favorite title and optimize for search or ask ChatGPT which it feels is best optimized for search (this is very important if you're a new channel)
Prompt Templates:
"Can you please optimize this title [paste title] for youtube SEARCH"
"Of the titles you just suggested, which do you think is most optimized for youtube SEARCH"
Then finally, it's time to start planning or writing. You have two options here.
Either write the outline yourself, and then paste that into CHAT and ask it to write your script
OR
Ask ChatGPT for a video outline to get the gears moving in your brain
